Job work management on paper: material goes out to the plating, machining and paint vendors on handwritten challans, some of it comes back, and nobody can say which vendor still has what. Meanwhile the customer wants a dispatch date and someone spends the afternoon calling vendors.

Fine Solves builds custom products for manufacturing owners. For job work, that means one screen for every challan: what went out, what came back and what is still at the vendor, updated when the material returns, alongside vendors, stock and dispatch. Built around how your plant already works, and live in weeks.
